quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on his strained relationship with Elon Musk

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on Nico Harrison's tenure as Mavericks GM
quotes.excerpt: You could just tell that Nico just shit on Luka. Just shit on a bad, because some of the stuff that Patrick was telling me was not true.
quotes.quote: You could just tell that Nico just shit on Luka. Just shit on a bad, because some of the stuff that Patrick was telling me was not true. Finn was the guy who said this is the wrong thing to do. Now Dirk didn't agree with everything that was going on. He didn't agree with the Nico hiring.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban reflects on his 23-year tenure as Mavericks owner
quotes.excerpt: It was a good run. I'm not one to kind of look back and just reflect on this or that. It was a good run.
quotes.quote: It was a good run. I'm not one to kind of look back and just reflect on this or that. It was a good run. I had fun most of the time. Winning is fun, losing is worse. But the people were great, getting to know everybody from Dirk, you just name it.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on his involvement in the Mavericks' draft process
quotes.excerpt: He definitely wanted me there on draft night. He definitely wanted me to be a part of it.
quotes.quote: He definitely wanted me there on draft night. He definitely wanted me to be a part of it. We talked about the thought process. He was like, 'Oh, we need a point guard.' I'm like, 'Well, you go for the best player available. You're not turning down Michael Jordan or Dirk Nowitzki just so you say you have a point guard.'

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban recalls the Danny Fortson trade
quotes.excerpt: I remember trading for Danny Fortson, and literally it was the largest trade in NBA history at the time.
quotes.quote: I remember trading for Danny Fortson, and literally it was the largest trade in NBA history at the time. There was like eight guys and four teams. And I was the one calling the general managers because I wanted to learn. I wanted to get a sense of how everything worked.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on Nico Harrison's behind-the-scenes maneuvering
quotes.excerpt: He's going to give you a report. Every two weeks you're going to get a report and you sit down.
quotes.quote: He's going to give you a report. Every two weeks you're going to get a report and you sit down. And then, oh yeah, I want you to talk more with Nico, get down there with Nico. And then obviously Nico was talking trash behind the scenes. But again, we're winning. I don't want to create a problem when things are going well.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on his role in acquiring Kristaps Porzingis
quotes.excerpt: I'm the one that talked to the other team's owner and was saying to our team, 'Look, I like Kristaps, but we're giving up a lot.'
quotes.quote: I'm the one that talked to the other team's owner and was saying to our team, 'Look, I like Kristaps, but we're giving up a lot. But if you, if, you know, if we're going to get this done, I'll get it done.'

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on the failed Kyle Kuzma trade
quotes.excerpt: He wanted Kyle Kuzma, I don't want Kyle Kuzma. That didn't, you know, and it didn't go down.
quotes.quote: He wanted Kyle Kuzma, I don't want Kyle Kuzma. That didn't, you know, and it didn't go down. But Kyrie, yeah, that was all me talking because Kyrie was damaged goods at the time.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on players' affinity for Kyrie Irving
quotes.excerpt: I was talking to every player I could. And watching after every game that Kyrie played when he was in Brooklyn.
quotes.quote: I was talking to every player I could. And watching after every game that Kyrie played when he was in Brooklyn, every player on the other team tried to go up there and hug him.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on how to handle Kyrie Irving's trade value
quotes.excerpt: The first thing you do is you talk to Kyrie. And you do whatever Kyrie wants because that's what Kyrie has earned.
quotes.quote: The first thing you do is you talk to Kyrie. And you do whatever Kyrie wants because that's what Kyrie has earned. He's not just some guy. He got us to the finals, and is just one of the best humans that you can meet.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on Nico Harrison's lack of communication regarding Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: Nico at that point, Nico wasn't talking to me at all.
quotes.quote: Nico at that point, Nico wasn't talking to me at all. I knew he was frustrated with Luka and Luka's team.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on Finn's opposition to the Nico Harrison hiring
quotes.excerpt: Finn was the guy who said this is the wrong thing to do.
quotes.quote: Finn was the guy who said this is the wrong thing to do.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on his relationship with Steve Nash and Victoria Vancouver
quotes.excerpt: Al grew up with Steve Nash and Victoria Vancouver, and Nashy brought him down to be one of the equipment managers.
quotes.quote: Al grew up with Steve Nash and Victoria Vancouver, and Nashy brought him down to be one of the equipment managers.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on the Mavericks' front office structure
quotes.excerpt: Masai and Nico are a lot alike, but they're different in the important ways.
quotes.quote: Masai and Nico are a lot alike, but they're different in the important ways. Nico wanted all his people in there, and you saw how many people he got rid of and who he got rid of. Masai's a lot of the same way. But Nico didn't really know what he was doing. I hired him to work for me, right, not to run the the the basketball operations.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on the Mavericks' corporate culture
quotes.excerpt: One of the challenges the Mavs have right now is they're very corporate. Gina's great PR person, but she runs everything.
quotes.quote: One of the challenges the Mavs have right now is they're very corporate. Gina's great PR person, but she runs everything. It's a tight ship over there.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on the trust in Nico Harrison
quotes.excerpt: Even Patrick said, 'Nico, we trust.'
quotes.quote: Even Patrick said, 'Nico, we trust.'

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on Kyrie Irving's fourth-quarter dominance
quotes.excerpt: Because Kyrie is such a killer, that it comes to fourth quarter, he's trying to take over the game no matter what.
quotes.quote: Because Kyrie is such a killer, that it comes to fourth quarter, he's trying to take over the game no matter what. And you have to be cognizant of that if you're going for winning right off the bat.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on his decision not to make the Kyrie Irving contract restricted
quotes.excerpt: And you can argue we should have made it restricted, but and that was my decision not to make it restricted.
quotes.quote: And you can argue we should have made it restricted, but and that was my decision not to make it restricted.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on the importance of player relationships
quotes.excerpt: I explained to him that I needed somebody who had relationships with players already.
quotes.quote: I explained to him that I needed somebody who had relationships with players already. And that was what we were missing that we that was our weak suit. We hadn't had all that much success on luring top-notch free agents. And Nico, you know, worked with them closely, and so he knew all these people.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on his relationship with Donnie Nelson
quotes.excerpt: I mean sometimes it's just time. It's just time to to evolve over. I love Donnie, you know.
quotes.quote: I mean sometimes it's just time. It's just time to to evolve over. I love Donnie, you know. Nothing bad to say about him at all. You know, he was an integral part of the organization, taught me a lot. But sometimes, you know, you know, Rick was leaving and so it was like, okay, now's the time.
